name: ExR Education
summary: ExR Education is brought to medical professionals by three founders who are experts in their retrospective fields. One a practising surgeon, one a triple-A games artist, and the final a film maker. Each of their skillsets enables them to create immersive experiences that can replicate real-life medical scenarios to boost the technical competencies of learners for medical procedures and processes.
